description: Removes dependencies from a Rust project and returns structured output.

dryRun.description: Preview what would be removed without modifying Cargo.toml (--dry-run)

frozen.description: Require Cargo.lock and cache are up to date (--frozen)

locked.description: Require Cargo.lock is up to date (--locked)

package.description: Package to target in a workspace (-p <SPEC>)

name: remove

dependencyType.description: Type of dependency that was removed: normal, dev, or build

failedPackages.description: Package names that failed to remove in a multi-package remove operation

partialSuccess.description: True when at least one package was removed but one or more removals failed

title: Cargo Remove
